claim_ceiling: code-order sensitivity and synthetic conformance; not jobs, time, ROI or mission success

logical_occupation_activity_source.sql: SELECT oa.activity_id, o.source_code FROM curated.occupation_activity oa JOIN curated.occupation o USING (occupation_id) ORDER BY oa.activity_id, o.source_code

rights: Original aggregate statistics and derived trial outcomes only; no source text, raw model generation, WEF/WORKBank records or labour-force microdata.

scaffold.semantic_outcome: Hardened comparator applied during extraction; public replay aggregates derived outcomes, not omitted prose
scaffold.suite_outcome: Recorded historical suite/domain boolean, not regraded without private deliverables in the public replay

sensitivity.cohort: final 2026-08-12 work-mode partition; additive replay, not the unfrozen work-mode checkpoint of the historical 108-grid
sensitivity.weight_rule: one vote or O*NET importance or group employment mass; groups divide their share across distinct linked activities; missing weights contribute zero; none measures task time
